title: Suspect at large after a stolen car was found in an Evansville parking lot - NewsBreak
text: HENDERSON, Ky. (WEHT) — A woman was arrested and a male suspect is at large after a stolen car was found abandoned in an Evansville parking lot. A release from the Vanderburgh County Sheriff’s Office says deputies were dispatched to the 900 block of East Mount Pleasant Road after a call was made about an abandoned vehicle. Deputies later learned the car had been reported as stolen. The release goes on to say that a male and female subject were seen walking in the area. When a deputy approached the two, they say they fled the scene. The deputy was able to detain the woman who initially provided a false identity. She was later identified as Cassidy Lynn Gross, who was found to have multiple outstanding warrants for her arrest. Deputies say they searched for three hours but was unable to locate the male suspect. The suspect is described as a white male, approximately 5’10” tall, weighing 160 pounds, with multiple tattoos covering his arms, back, and face. He was last seen wearing blue jean shorts, with no shirt or shoes.
